name: KIRYU
about: The C example KIRYU rebuilt in blocks: 30 spins of the Mechagodzilla spinner start it, the lit shots charge the Absolute Zero, and from 100% the captive ball or the Action button fires it - or push on to x2, x3, x4 while the reactor overheats and may vent.
lost: The badge always counts the mode's 40 s clock: while the reactor overheats the C counted the overheat's 12 s there instead. The overheat's seconds now ride on the line (OVERHEATING! FIRE NOW 9).
The counters show bare numbers: CHARGE 109 where the C showed 109%, MULTIPLIER 2 where it showed X2.
The gauge stays one ice blue labelled CHARGE: the C shaded its ten pips from blue to white and relabelled it OVERHEAT while overheating and FIRED after the shot.
The spin count note reads SPINS TO KIRYU 29 (the number after the words) where the C said 29 SPINS TO KIRYU.

When the clock runs out at 100% or more Kiryu still fires on its own (x1, 10M, no bonus), but at the end itself: the C played the shot's 4-second moment (its clip and frost light show) before KIRYU WINS.
After firing, the badge keeps counting (the clock is only held at 5 s or more) where the C stopped and hid it for the shot's moment.
The ending (KIRYU WINS or KIRYU IS DOWN, its line and the total) stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.
No debounce: the C counted the same target once in 250 ms (a bouncing standup pays once); the blocks count every report.
A hit no longer answers by itself: the C flashed every charging shot's inserts white and played the game's climbing orchestra hit (PAD-415).
Its ending call plays after one of the game's own modes ends it too (the C kept quiet then, as it does for a drain or a tilt).
Its own start and end light shows are gone: the C used them only on a game without the game's Strobe burst and Blue fade, which Godzilla Premium/LE has.
For Godzilla Premium/LE only: the C also ran on Godzilla Pro (its Right spinner, no Shield target center), and a blocks program names one spinner.

intro.what: Kiryu's face at night against an orange sky, its eyes light up yellow and the head turns as it comes online, 1:02:21.2.

loop.what: Kiryu's head in profile against the sunset sky, red eye glowing, almost still, 0:45:22.0.

charge.what: Kiryu faces the camera in the night city as the Absolute Zero cannon in its chest glows orange then blue white, 1:08:59.0.

ready.what: Close-up of Kiryu's twin shoulder cannons, the camera rising to its head against a blue sky, 0:41:12.0.

fire.what: A run of quick shots: the Absolute Zero beam fires and streaks blue white across the night city, 1:09:09.9.

overheat.what: Kiryu stands engulfed in fireballs and billowing smoke, 0:41:56.9.

won.what: Wounded Godzilla stands in the frozen sea at dusk as ice falls around him and he roars in pain, 1:19:02.2.

lost.what: Close on Kiryu's head at sunset as its red eye fades out and the machine goes dead, 0:45:31.0.

music.what: End-credits orchestral score by Michiru Oshima, a repeating phrase over a steady pulse with no dialogue or effects, 1:24:27.2.

charge.what: A rising rush of energy as Kiryu's chest cannon charges at dusk, peaking and falling away, 1:17:40.2.

ready.what: Kiryu's mechanical blast with a high metallic whine as it squares up to Godzilla at night, 1:03:22.4.

fire.what: The Absolute Zero cannon fires, a hissing blast and a second burst as the beam crosses the city, 1:09:09.1.

overheat.what: Crackling electric discharge with a falling whine after the Absolute Zero shot, 1:09:15.2.

won.what: A rushing whoosh and the huge booming eruption as the Absolute Zero blast freezes the sea, 1:18:17.4.

lost.what: Godzilla's roar, the cry that sends Kiryu out of control, 0:39:58.3.
